احتسبن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَسَبْنَ (iḥtasabna) /iħ.ta.sab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# اُحْتُسِبْنَ (uḥtusibna) /uħ.tu.sib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# اِحْتَسِبْنَ (iḥtasibna) /iħ.ta.sib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
